newsitem.title: USA: Shells Seafood says to open new restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Shells Seafood says to open new restaurants.

text.p: Shells Seafood Restaurants Inc said on Tuesday that it plans to open 10 to 12 new restaurants in 1997 in the Florida and Midwest markets.
The company announced the plan in its first quarterly earnings report, during which it posted a net income increase of 51 percent to $919,000 from $608,000 for the same period last year.
However, as a percentage of revenues, net income decreased to 5.4 percent in the first quarter, from 5.7 percent in the same period in 1996, the company said.

It said the percentage decline was due primarily to higher hourly labor costs associated with the opening of six new restaurants in late December 1996. The company added that it expects to incur higher hourly labor costs still as it expands into Midwest markets.
Shells opened a new restaurant in Florida in the first quarter of 1997, the company said, and it plans to open three more restaurants during the second quarter.
Shells currently manages and operates 32 casual dining seafood restaurants in Florida.
